symptom.name: No Display or Dead
symptom.description: The unit is dead or the display does not operate.

failure_modes.name: Fuse has no continuity (open fuse)
failure_modes.description: The fuse has no continuity in the continuity test between the ends of the fuse.

failure_modes.name: Noise filter has no continuity
failure_modes.description: The noise filter has no continuity in the continuity test between the ends of the noise filter.

corrective_actions.name: Replace the fuse
corrective_actions.source_title: LG LMH2235ST Microwave Oven Service Manual

corrective_actions.name: Replace the noise filter
corrective_actions.source_title: LG LMH2235ST Microwave Oven Service Manual

symptom.name: Keypad Failure
symptom.description: Keys other than START and EZ-ON do not operate.

failure_modes.name: Latch board secondary switch has no continuity
failure_modes.description: No beeping sound in the continuity test between the ends of the latch board secondary switch with the door closed.

corrective_actions.name: Adjust the latch board
corrective_actions.description: Adjust the latch board (refer to section 9-1, 9-2).
corrective_actions.instruction_text: Adjust the latch board (refer to section 9-1, 9-2).
corrective_actions.source_title: LG LMH2235ST Microwave Oven Service Manual

symptom.name: No Heat / No Cook
symptom.description: The product operates but does not heat or cook.

failure_modes.name: Resistance of the high voltage transformer out of range
failure_modes.description: High voltage transformer winding resistance outside the test point ranges.

failure_modes.name: Resistance of the high voltage capacitor out of range
failure_modes.description: High voltage capacitor resistance out of range.

failure_modes.name: Resistance of the high voltage diode out of range
failure_modes.description: High voltage diode resistance out of range.

corrective_actions.name: Replace the high voltage transformer
corrective_actions.source_title: LG LMH2235ST Microwave Oven Service Manual

corrective_actions.name: Replace the high voltage capacitor
corrective_actions.source_title: LG LMH2235ST Microwave Oven Service Manual

corrective_actions.name: Replace the high voltage diode
corrective_actions.source_title: LG LMH2235ST Microwave Oven Service Manual

symptom.name: Turntable Motor Does Not Work
symptom.description: The turntable motor does not operate.

failure_modes.name: Turntable motor does not operate although the oven lamp turns on
failure_modes.description: The turntable motor does not operate although the oven lamp turns on with the door closed.

corrective_actions.name: Replace the turntable motor
corrective_actions.source_title: LG LMH2235ST Microwave Oven Service Manual
